headline: Why is my roof leaking after a small storm?
articleBody: It's super frustrating when even a light rain causes a leak, right? You'd think a small storm wouldn't be a big deal, but often those little leaks are actually red flags pointing to bigger issues with your roof's integrity. It's not always about a massive hole; sometimes it's subtle, like compromised flashing around chimneys or skylights. Over time, sealants can wear down, or even a few missing shingles can let water creep in. Don't just patch it and forget it, because water damage can spread quickly and secretly behind your walls or in your attic, leading to mold or structural problems. A quick fix might seem economical now, but it usually costs more down the line. It's always best to have a professional general contractor, like us, take a look. We'll identify the root cause, whether it's a minor repair or a sign that your roof is reaching the end of its lifespan. Catching these problems early can save you a ton of stress and money. Give us a call, and we can help you figure out what's really going on up there before it turns into a major headache.
